problem:
Let $V={R}_{1}[t],$ the vector space of polynomials of degree at most $1$ with real coefficients. Given that the inner product on $V$ is defined as 

$$
⟨p(t),q(t)⟩=p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1),
$$

find the distance between $f(t)=5t$ and $g(t)=7t-8$ with respect to the inner product.
worked_solution:
The distance between $f(t)=5t$ and $g(t)=7t-8$ with respect to the given inner product is

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =‖f(t)-g(t)‖ \\  & =‖5t-(7t-8)‖ \\  & =‖-2t+8‖ \\  & =\sqrt{⟨-2t+8,-2t+8⟩}.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the inner product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨-2t+8,-2t+8⟩ & =(-2t+8){|}_{0}\cdot (-2t+8){|}_{0}+(-2t+8){|}_{1}\cdot (-2t+8){|}_{1} \\  & =8\cdot 8+6\cdot 6 \\  & =100.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the distance is $d=\sqrt{100}=10.$
